children: New investors have continued buying Bitcoin even as spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds have been selling, according to Bitfinex.
On October 17, the cryptocurrency exchange wrote on X, formerly Twitter, that new Bitcoin buyers have added about 570,000 BTC since late July despite ETF selling.
Bitfinex said their average purchase price was about $75,000. That level has acted as support each time Bitcoin has pulled back since August.
The exchange said buying by new market participants has helped support the lower end of Bitcoin's price range even as ETF fund flows have weakened.

title: New Bitcoin Buyers Accumulated 570,000 BTC Since Late July at Average Cost of $75,000, Bitfinex Says
